name: Bats

variantInfo.name: Bat
notes: The regular Bat has 8 Hitpoints and max hit 1 (stab); 8 Slayer XP per kill.
35% elemental weakness to air spells; drops only bat bones or nothing.

variantInfo.name: Giant bat
notes: The Giant bat is the most common variety counted: 32 Hitpoints, max hit 3 (stab), 32 Slayer XP.
10% elemental weakness to air spells (added 25 June 2025); aggressive to players of combat level 54 or lower except in Arceuus.
Higher bat variants (Albino bat lvl52 requires Cabin Fever; Death wing lvl83 requires Legends' Quest progress) also count but are inefficient and their stats are honest-UNKNOWN here.

locationComparison.name: Bat spawns (various)
notes: Bats and giant bats are spread across many low-density spots; no single canonical spawn count is wiki-stated (honest UNKNOWN), so no amount overlay is authored.
Bats drop only bat bones or nothing, so the task is a starter Slayer-XP task.

taskNotes: Bats require combat level 5 to be assigned by Turael, Spria, or Mazchna; there is no Slayer level or quest requirement.
slayerTargetId 276 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.

Five bat types count: Bat (lvl6), Giant bat (lvl27, most common), Albino bat (lvl52, Cabin Fever), Death wing (lvl83, Legends' Quest), and other bats; only Bat and Giant bat stats are authored, the rest are honest-UNKNOWN.
The Giant bat has 32 Hitpoints, max hit 3 (stab melee), 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 22.
Bats have an elemental weakness to air spells (35% on the Bat, 10% on the Giant bat).
No required protective item and no task extension unlock exist for Bats.
recommendedMethod: A low-level Slayer-XP task: kill Giant bats (the most common variety) or regular Bats with any melee weapon. Air spells exploit the elemental weakness for a Magic-training alternative. Bats drop only bat bones, so the task is done for Slayer XP and the streak rather than loot.
